articles.title: Circle slides after Morgan Stanley downgrade, cut in price target
articles.snippet: The bank said tokenized money market funds, Open USD and slower USDC growth could weigh on the stablecoin issuer's earnings.

articles.title: BlackRock expands tokenized cash with new blockchain-based money market offerings
articles.snippet: Both funds intend to qualify as eligible reserve assets for permitted U.S. payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act.

articles.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market funds for stablecoin reserves
articles.snippet: The asset manager introduced two blockchain-based money market funds designed to qualify as stablecoin reserve assets under the US GENIUS Act.

articles.title: South Korean stablecoin outflows top $367M in June: Report
articles.snippet: Stablecoins have been flowing out of South Korean exchanges for 18 consecutive months as regulators weigh tighter oversight of cross-border crypto activity.

articles.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds on Solana, Ethereum
articles.snippet: BlackRock launched a tokenized money market fund for stablecoin reserves that uses Solana alongside Ethereum.
